still

A quieter kind of progress.

Still UI v8 · Classical editorial. Five iPhone screens rebuilt in editable HTML and CSS, with embedded artwork and fonts.

Design study · 06 Nov 2026
Interactive design preview

Art gives the atmosphere. Practice gives the value.

This v8 study replaces the comic visual direction with classical fine art, editorial typography, quiet surfaces and clear actions. The app remains for retail traders across all markets. It provides habit practice, not signals, market data or trading execution.

Ivory · #F5F2EBStone · #DAD8D2Sky · #AABAC4Ink · #20201DAntique gold · #B69A64
Preview scope & artwork rights

All screen copy and controls are editable HTML/CSS, not full-screen image screenshots. Artwork-only crops come from the approved AI-generated classical UI concepts, created using user-supplied visual references. They have not undergone source/licence verification or copyright clearance. Treat them as concept imagery; replace or clear final artwork before commercial app, landing-page or advertising publication.

This local demo has no backend, external tracking, accounts, purchases or broker connection. Task choices and the optional reflection are held only on the current page and reset on reload. “Sign in”, “Log”, “Tools” and “Me” show preview notices rather than unfinished navigation. The five-screen selector, primary navigation, answer choices and Pause flow are interactive.

Offline file & typeface licences

Artwork, icons, CSS, JavaScript and fonts are embedded. Open this file directly in a browser; no server, CDN or font request is required. Display type uses Cormorant Garamond; functional copy uses Manrope. Both original font families are embedded under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. Converted to WOFF2 without changing the typeface design.

Font sources: Cormorant Garamond and Manrope.
